name: popsicle
headline: Social Media Video Downloader: Multi-Platform
short_description: Open-source tool built with Python and Flet to download videos, photos, and stories from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter/X, and Pinterest .  fast, customizable, and easy to use.
author: smtozkn06

sections.overview:
Social Media Video Downloader is a Python application built with Flet that enables users to download videos, photos, and stories from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest. The tool supports bulk downloads, playlist handling, and includes a built-in TikTok video editor. It features a clean, responsive UI with multi-language support (Turkish and English), customizable quality settings, and optimized download speeds. Users simply select a platform, paste a URL, and initiate downloads—ideal for content creators, researchers, and individuals needing to archive or repurpose social media content.
Download entire YouTube playlists for offline viewing
Bulk download TikTok videos for content analysis or archiving
Save Instagram stories and posts before they expire
Extract and edit TikTok videos with the built-in editor
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/smtozkn06/Social-Media-Video-Downloader`

Download social media videos using the Social-Media-Video-Downloader tool. I need to download [NUMBER] videos from [PLATFORM] with the following URLs: [URL1], [URL2], etc. Save them in [FORMAT] format to [LOCATION].
